_comment: Surface-condition scoring policy skeleton. Owned by ML role. The scoring engine (backend/scoring/) is NOT yet implemented and no known-good reference has been fitted, so every threshold and weight here is deliberately null. Final plan section 9.2 and tasks F6-F8 forbid copying the 70/40 bands or inventing weights: Good/Bad thresholds must be derived from grouped development tradeoffs once human-rated examples exist. This file is the contract shape, not a set of numbers.
_status: Not calibrated. No human-rated condition labels exist yet (task F6), so no probability calibration is supported. Until it is, any output must be labelled a provisional reference-deviation index, NOT a validated SQI (task F7, final plan section 9.2 item 5).

texture_deviation_T._note: Robust normalized-deviation or shrinkage Mahalanobis against a reviewed good-surface reference (tasks F1-F2). Reference not yet fitted.

distress_burden_D.source: backend/distress/ measured extent and skeleton length
distress_burden_D._note: Observed defect fraction/length and distribution. Definitions must be stable before fitting (final plan section 9.2).

distribution_term.source: at most ONE distribution term (e.g. gap median/tail)
distribution_term._note: Final plan section 9.2 caps this at one distribution term to avoid a descriptor soup.

sqi._note: SQI may only be emitted if probability calibration is supported (task F7). Otherwise emit a provisional reference-deviation index with a review label.

thresholds._note: Derived from development tradeoffs only (task F8). Never copied from a 70/40 band.

null_policy._note: Missing mandatory evidence yields score=null unless a separately evaluated partial-input rule exists (task F9). null is never replaced by a number.
